Horrible, avoid it.
May 2026 • Couples
We wanted to have dinner tonight at MANGO D HOI AN for 2 people; we ordered 
_ a shrimp dish: not cooked, very lightly seasoned. 
_ Duck rolls; 2 long croquettes stuffed with a McDonald's-style potato puree.
 - a local beer 
 - a Spritz: 3/4 ice. 
All of this in a beautiful room with a table of about fifteen people yelling like in a soccer stadium!!!!!
We cut the meal short and paid for our 2 dishes while pointing out the terrible atmosphere and the quality of the dishes... we were then offered to change tables and given a complimentary ice cream... which we refused. 
Evening ruined for 900 VND. 
We finished our meal in a very nice, calm local restaurant for 4 times less expensive... 
AVOID.....
